tools.name: get_supplier_capabilities
tools.description: Returns Cintra's supported categories, accepted inputs, and the quote-to-order flow available over this server.

tools.name: submit_rfq
tools.description: Submits a parts list for a wholesale quote and returns an rfq_id. Poll get_quote(rfq_id) until status is 'ready'; the priced quote is also emailed to buyer_email. Non-binding; no charge occurs at this step.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns the current state of a quote. status is 'pending' while it is being priced, 'ready' once priced (with total and line pricing), 'accepted' once ordered, or 'expired'.

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Accepts a 'ready' quote and returns an order_id. When online payment is enabled it also returns a secure payment link the buyer completes; otherwise Cintra emails the invoice to the buyer.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns an accepted order's status: awaiting payment, paid, or awaiting an emailed invoice; with amount and any payment link. Fulfillment updates are added to the record as they occur.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "submit_rfq" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: lines, buyer_email, company, contact_name, ship_to_zip, needed_by, context, account_number

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_rfq" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Submits a parts list for a wholesale quote and returns an rfq_id. Poll get_quote(rfq_id) until status is 'ready'. Non-binding; no charge occurs at this step." → after: "Submits a parts list for a wholesale quote and returns an rfq_id. Poll get_quote(rfq_id) until status is 'ready'; the priced quote is also emailed to buyer_email. Non-binding; no charge occurs at this step."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan

Accepting a quote whose payment is settled confirms the order." → after: "Accepts a 'ready' quote and returns an order_id. When online payment is enabled it also returns a secure payment link the buyer completes; otherwise Cintra emails the invoice to the buyer."
